calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH p4_this_year AS (
  SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 4
),
p4_last_year AS (
  SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 4
)
SELECT 
  'This Year (FY2026/27 P04)' as period_label,
  ty.period_start_date,
  ty.period_end_date
FROM p4_this_year ty
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Last Year (FY2025/26 P04)' as period_label,
  ly.period_start_date,
  ly.period_end_date
FROM p4_last_year ly

WITH p4_this_year AS (
  SELECT fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900  -- Physical stores only
  GROUP BY fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name
),
p4_last_year AS (
  SELECT fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900  -- Physical stores only
  GROUP BY fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name
)
SELECT 
  ty.store_id,
  ty.store_name,
  ty.net_sales as sales_fy2026_27_p04,
  ly.net_sales as sales_fy2025_26_p04,
  CASE WHEN ly.net_sales > 0 THEN ROUND((ty.net_sales - ly.net_sales) / ly.net_sales * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END as lfl_growth_pct
FROM p4_this_year ty
INNER JOIN p4_last_year ly ON ty.store_id = ly.store_id
ORDER BY ty.store_id

WITH p4_this_year AS (
  SELECT fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region, SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region
),
p4_last_year AS (
  SELECT fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region, SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region
),
lfl AS (
  SELECT 
    ty.region,
    SUM(ty.net_sales) as sales_fy2026_27_p04,
    SUM(ly.net_sales) as sales_fy2025_26_p04
  FROM p4_this_year ty
  INNER JOIN p4_last_year ly ON ty.store_id = ly.store_id
  GROUP BY ty.region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  ROUND(sales_fy2025_26_p04, 2) as fy2025_26_p04_net_sales,
  ROUND(sales_fy2026_27_p04, 2) as fy2026_27_p04_net_sales,
  ROUND((sales_fy2026_27_p04 - sales_fy2025_26_p04) / sales_fy2025_26_p04 * 100, 2) as lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl
ORDER BY region

WITH p4_this_year AS (
  SELECT fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY fsl.store_key, ds.store_id
),
p4_last_year AS (
  SELECT fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY fsl.store_key, ds.store_id
),
lfl AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(ty.net_sales) as sales_fy2026_27_p04,
    SUM(ly.net_sales) as sales_fy2025_26_p04,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ty.store_id) as store_count
  FROM p4_this_year ty
  INNER JOIN p4_last_year ly ON ty.store_id = ly.store_id
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(sales_fy2025_26_p04, 2) as fy2025_26_p04_net_sales,
  ROUND(sales_fy2026_27_p04, 2) as fy2026_27_p04_net_sales,
  ROUND((sales_fy2026_27_p04 - sales_fy2025_26_p04) / sales_fy2025_26_p04 * 100, 2) as lfl_growth_pct,
  store_count
FROM lfl

WITH p4_this_year_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.store_id, ds.store_name
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
),
p4_last_year_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.store_id, ds.store_name
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(ty.store_id, ly.store_id) as store_id,
  COALESCE(ty.store_name, ly.store_name) as store_name,
  CASE WHEN ty.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as in_fy2026_27_p04,
  CASE WHEN ly.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as in_fy2025_26_p04
FROM p4_this_year_stores ty
FULL OUTER JOIN p4_last_year_stores ly ON ty.store_id = ly.store_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(ty.store_id, ly.store_id)

WITH p4_this_year AS (
  SELECT fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region, SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region
),
p4_last_year AS (
  SELECT fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region, SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region
),
lfl_by_region AS (
  SELECT 
    ty.region,
    SUM(ty.net_sales) as sales_fy2026_27_p04,
    SUM(ly.net_sales) as sales_fy2025_26_p04,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ty.store_id) as store_count
  FROM p4_this_year ty
  INNER JOIN p4_last_year ly ON ty.store_id = ly.store_id
  GROUP BY ty.region
),
lfl_total AS (
  SELECT 
    'Total' as region,
    SUM(sales_fy2026_27_p04) as sales_fy2026_27_p04,
    SUM(sales_fy2025_26_p04) as sales_fy2025_26_p04,
    SUM(store_count) as store_count
  FROM lfl_by_region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  ROUND(sales_fy2025_26_p04, 2) as fy2025_26_p04_net_sales,
  ROUND(sales_fy2026_27_p04, 2) as fy2026_27_p04_net_sales,
  ROUND((sales_fy2026_27_p04 - sales_fy2025_26_p04) / sales_fy2025_26_p04 * 100, 2) as lfl_growth_pct,
  store_count
FROM (
  SELECT region, sales_fy2026_27_p04, sales_fy2025_26_p04, store_count FROM lfl_by_region
  UNION ALL
  SELECT region, sales_fy2026_27_p04, sales_fy2025_26_p04, store_count FROM lfl_total
)
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN region = 'Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  region
